entries.title: Copy a saved secret's value from Settings
entries.body: A secret's row in Settings, Secrets, now has Copy value. Each press asks your computer to confirm it is you, then puts the value on this computer's clipboard. On a Mac it never reaches your other devices, and on a Windows PC it stays out of clipboard history; on Linux a clipboard history tool may still keep it. Infinitary clears it 90 seconds later, on Clear now or when you quit, unless you copied something else since. Each copy shows in the history as Copied by you.

picture.alt: A secret's row in Settings, Secrets, saying its value is on the clipboard until a time, with Clear now
